### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`  _(via PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID (literal, a string literal in judgeWithheldMaps))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `99b84e01cdcdb13d00eb8c468626b5d489bd4d8e` — the merge of head `85d56fc4e07d81342f9b269d77ec4772605e5868` into base `be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 99b84e01cdcdb13d00eb8c468626b5d489bd4d8e && git checkout 99b84e01cdcdb13d00eb8c468626b5d489bd4d8e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2 85d56fc4e07d81342f9b269d77ec4772605e5868 && git checkout -B drift-repro be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2 && git merge --no-ff 85d56fc4e07d81342f9b269d77ec4772605e5868

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs be6b15c7cb309cf89358332e5927b4763e9c82a2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c5a341477a90422cdf74532ca4cc0de3c85b03bd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts + packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-unmanaged-install.ts, packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts

Inputs read: card #29342 (body + all 11 comments, rulings 6578196369 / 6592752231 included), PR #29746 body, file list and net diff `origin/main...c5a34147` (10 files, +699/−37, merge base 33ee9aa1), and the head's check-runs. Read-only: the diff was read with `git show`/`git diff` on a fetched ref; nothing was checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Export response widens by one declared optional key.** `GET /packages/:id/export` (route-ledger row `responseSchema: 'PackageExportManifestSchema'`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:567`) now writes `withheldMaps` when at least one connector map was withheld, omitted otherwise. The key, its closed element shape and its four-value `path` enum were already declared on `main` by #29521; the PR adds no key, value or type to the schema. **Right** — the runtime test parses the export through `PackageExportManifestSchema` and the list is preserved.
- **Spec change is describe/docblock only.** In `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` the `[PLANNED — not yet served]` prefix leaves `withheldMaps.describe`, the member docblock and the module docblock say served, and no `z.*` call changes; `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` is the regenerated artifact of exactly that. In `kernel/unmanaged-install.ts` only the comment on the `withheldMaps: 'door'` row changes; the row, the disposition union and the refusing set are untouched, and `unmanaged-install.test.ts` is not in the diff (its `toBe('door')` pin still holds). **Right** — the hits files publish no accept-set or type change.
- **install-local answers gain one optional key in both modes** (`withheldMaps`, omitted when the body carries none, so the key set of an answer without it is unchanged). No spec schema declares that answer: the runtime route ledger has no `marketplace/install-local` row and `packages/spec/src/api` has no install-local response schema, so this is an undeclared-surface widening with no transcription owed. **Right.**
- **install-local accept set narrows for a malformed `withheldMaps`** (`judgeWithheldMaps`: `PackageExportManifestSchema.shape.withheldMaps.safeParse`, refused `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` 400 inline / 502 cloud, before any write, both modes). `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` is already in the error-code ledger (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts:1304`), and the status pair is the one `judgeInstallMode` already uses. **Right**, see ② for the Clause-② reading.
- **The unmanaged copy never carries the key.** The planner (`package-unmanaged-install.ts:426`, `case 'door': break`) skips `withheldMaps` because of the row already on `main`; the PR's door reads it before `importUnmanagedPackage` runs. **Right** — the `door` row's comment now describes a reader that exists.
- **Runtime-internal:** `PackagesDomainProtocol` gains an optional `getMetaItemForExecution` member typed off the producer's own signature; the protocol's request type has `packageId?: string`, so the call `{ type: 'connector', name, packageId }` is in-contract. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/29342-export-withheld-connector-maps.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/spec`, carrying `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, and naming the narrowing arm in prose. PR body carries the same two lines. Per AGENTS.md Post-Task §3, `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch` — **matches** what the diff publishes (no authorable key changes anywhere; `withheldMaps` is not authorable on any item, the connector bodies stay byte-identical as served).
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` **holds** for the export (one declared optional key starts being written) and for the two install answers. The narrowing arm (a malformed `withheldMaps` refused as `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`) is, as the seat's amendment 6592752231 put it, the spec's own refusal made real: the closed element shape and the four-value enum were published with the key on `main` before any producer wrote it, so no consumer ever held a capability the door now takes away — only a hand-written value the declaration already refused is refused. AGENTS.md allows at most one arm on the line, `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, and this PR carries no BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 disposition and no `!` in its title. I accept the line as written on that reading; the arm is named in prose in both the PR body and the changeset, which is the record the seat directed.
- The spec `patch` is right for a describe-only change (no `.d.ts` surface moves).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6594523288 lists `open_questions: []`; the three questions of the first dev report (6578135265) were all answered by seat ruling 6578196369 (option A; import accepts and names; the connector's four maps only, webhook headers out). The tree follows all three.
- Out-of-scope findings in the dev report, each answered here: (a) the per-package export carries no `type`/`installModes`, so the bare export refuses an unmanaged import — pre-existing export-manifest-key family, carrier #28914; **not this PR's** (the dogfood adds the two keys and says so in its header). (b) `installUnmanaged` logs a 4xx reason only when status ≥ 500 — pre-existing; the dev reported it to the seat for filing (class a); **not this PR's**. (c) webhook `headers` dropped the same way — ruling 3A keeps it out of scope; **right to leave**.
- Read-only observation, not escalated: the runtime's own managed door `POST /api/v1/packages` parses the manifest through `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (= `ManifestSchema`, a `strictObject`), which refuses an export carrying `withheldMaps` — but it already refuses the export's `label` on `main`, and ruling A names install-local (the door the Studio import button posts to, `PackagesPage.tsx:1544`) as the reader. No regression attributable to this PR; belongs with the #28914 export-manifest-key family if anyone wants that door to accept exports.
- Check-runs on `c5a34147` at read time: 62 runs — 26 `success`, 8 `skipped`, 28 `in_progress` (Test Core 1–8, Test UI 1–16, Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace, Build Core, Live E2E UI), **0 failures**. The gate verdicts are therefore not all in yet; the queue guard reads them itself before landing. The dev's own run (105/105 dispatch-gate families exit 0, runtime/cloud-connection suites, lint) is the PR body's account and was not relied on.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`** — judged against seat ruling 6578196369 (option A), the director's ③A, and its first consumers (`assemblePackageManifest`, `judgeWithheldMaps`).
- The member docblock's new claim ("`assemblePackageManifest` writes the list, judging each exported connector's stored body with the same redactor the served read ran, and both install modes of `POST /marketplace/install-local` read it, accept the package and name each incomplete map") is **true of the tree**: `withheldConnectorMaps` (runtime `packages.ts`) calls `getMetadataTypeRedactor('connector')` — the built-in `redactConnectorItem`, the same function `decorateMetadataItem → redactMetadataItem` runs on the served face — on the body from `getMetaItemForExecution`, and keeps only the positions the declaration's own enum lists (`PackageExportManifestSchema.shape.withheldMaps.unwrap().element.shape.path.options`), so the two vocabularies cannot drift; `judgeWithheldMaps` parses the key by reference to the same declaration and both answers carry it.
- The by-name execution read is a legitimate reader: its docblock (`protocol.ts:4620–4627`) allows a gate inside a door to read a DECISION off it with no byte of the body reaching the response, and the hunk emits positions only; the runtime test pins that no header name or value leaves. Attempted breaks: (i) the two reads disagreeing — `getMetaItemsPerPackage` and `readMetaItem` hide a disabled package's items by the same predicate (`isItemOfDisabledPackage`), both read `active` state when none is passed, and `connector` is neither overridable nor bundled, so I found no scenario where the per-package list serves a connector the by-name read answers no body for; when it would, the export fails 500 rather than writing a false "nothing withheld", which the describe's "from an exporter that writes it, absence means nothing was withheld" requires. (ii) A cleared map (`{}`) is not in `redactedKeys` (`isClearedForm`), is served as written, and is correctly not listed. (iii) A map the redactor withholds under items 7/8 (undeclared keys) at one of the four paths is still listed, since only `redactedKeys` membership is read. Holds.
- The pin flip in `package-lifecycle.test.ts` asserts no `PLANNED` and `^Every map the export withheld WHOLE`, which the new describe satisfies; `#\d{3,}` still refused. The module docblock's "One member … the `nav` arm" is correct at the member level; it never counted `PackageExportBundleSchema` (#28914, a whole schema still marked PLANNED), and that omission pre-exists on `main` ("Two members" there also omits it) — noted, not a finding of this PR.
- **No must-fix. No should-fix.**

**`packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts`** — judged against the planner that reads the table and the door the comment names.
- Comment-only change on the `withheldMaps: 'door'` row; the new wording ("the install-local door reads it to name each incomplete map in its answer, and this row keeps the import from refusing an export that carries the key") is true of the tree: `installUnmanaged` receives the parsed list from `handleInstall` step 1d', the planner's `case 'door'` leaves the key out of the copy, and the answer and one `warn` line name each map. Table totality is unchanged (no key added or removed), so the `unmanaged-install.test.ts` battery is unaffected.
- **No must-fix. No should-fix.**

**Cited code read, not reviewed** (the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT` covers it): `withheldConnectorMaps` iterates `manifest.connectors` after the `ownDocumentsOf` filter and after `clean()`, so a connector's `name` is the served name; the hunk sits after the `dependencies` line and apart from #29687's filter as the PR says. The managed path's new `withheldMaps` spread and `warn` sit after every refusal and after the ledger write, so a refused install still writes nothing new.

Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZUR3xvHyDPCjNL5P4`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `18ad0f5b91e2225b6036f652086de6a7b3056d9c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts + content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx, PR #29742's `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` hunk (read through the REST file list, head be287545)

Delta record: one commit on top of `c5a34147` (reviewed PASS, record 6594653702), `git diff c5a34147 18ad0f5b` = 2 files, +6/−6: the header paragraph of `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` (lines 41–46) and its regenerated transcription in `package-lifecycle.mdx` (lines 46–50). `kernel/unmanaged-install.ts` is unchanged in the delta; every ① – ④ judgment of the earlier record stands for the rest of the tree and is not restated. Read-only: nothing checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set or public-surface change.** The delta touches a module-level docblock comment and the generated reference page only; no `z.*` call, type, key, row or export moves. **Right** — nothing publishes beyond prose.
- **What the header now says:** "One member is not a transcription but DECLARED AHEAD OF ITS PRODUCER … `PackageExportBundleSchema`, the whole-deployment export (#28914)." Against the tree at `18ad0f5b` that is **incomplete**: the same file still carries the `nav` arm's declared-ahead markers — the `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema` docblock (line 527–531, "the `nav` arm's describe opens `[PLANNED — not yet served]`"), the arm's leading comment (line 600) and its describe (line 619, `[PLANNED — not yet served] …`), plus the member-level and schema-level "not yet served" wording — none of which this PR drops. So at this head the header names one declared-ahead declaration while the file holds two (`nav` and the bundle). The previous head named `nav` and omitted the bundle (that omission pre-exists on `main`); this head names the bundle and omits `nav`. Nothing pins the header text (no test or script reads it; `git grep` on the head tree finds no pin), and the member-level pins in `package-lifecycle.test.ts` are the contract's truth and are untouched.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: the changeset (`patch` ×3, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) still matches what the diff publishes; the delta adds nothing publishable. **Matches.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The serial with #29742 (card #28722, seat 3, branch `claude/project-thread-f3xzh7`, head `be287545`, open draft, `mergeable_state: blocked`).** Its `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` hunk rewrites the SAME header lines from the SAME base text as this PR does ("Two declarations … `PackageExportManifestSchema.withheldMaps` (… served by #29342) and `PackageExportBundleSchema` …") and drops `nav`'s three markers and the member/schema-level "not yet served" wording; its `package-lifecycle.test.ts` hunk is the `nav` describe block at line 576+, disjoint from this PR's `withheldMaps` pin at line 241; both regenerate `package-lifecycle.mdx`. **The two header texts do not compose textually**: whichever PR lands second conflicts on lines 41–46 of the zod file and on the mdx header and must resolve by hand. **They do compose semantically**, and the resolution is the same in either order: once both are on `main`, the only declared-ahead declaration left in the file is `PackageExportBundleSchema`, which is exactly the text `18ad0f5b` already carries; #29742's text, naming `withheldMaps` as still declared ahead, is the one that is wrong after both land.
- **Landing order.** If #29742 lands first: this PR's re-merge resolves the header to its own current text, and the result is true on `main`. If #29746 lands first: `main`'s header is false by omission (it names one declared-ahead declaration while `nav`'s markers still stand in the same file) until #29742 lands and resolves its own conflict to the same one-declaration text. That window is a documentation inaccuracy in a non-normative header, bounded by #29742's landing, with no pin and no consumer reading it — **a should-fix, not a must-fix**, and **acceptable if the seat holds #29746's landing until #29742 lands** (the re-merge then forces the header conflict to be looked at anyway). If the seat instead needs #29746 to land first, the order-independent fix is to make the paragraph true at this head — name both `nav` (#27928, served by #28722) and `PackageExportBundleSchema` (#28914) — and let #29742 take `nav` out; that still conflicts textually with #29742, but leaves `main` truthful in the window.
- Check-runs on `18ad0f5b` at read time: 34 runs — 9 `success`, 7 `skipped`, 18 `in_progress` (Build Core, Build UI Deps, Build Docs, Plan Test Core shards, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, the Lint and Type Check families), **0 failures**. The gate verdicts on this head are not all in; the queue guard reads them itself before landing. `check:docs` is among them and judges that the mdx matches the docblock, which the delta's two hunks say it does.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`** — the delta is the header paragraph alone; judged against the file's own markers and against #29742's hunk.
- The paragraph is non-normative prose; the ADR-0049 convention's enforcement is the per-member `[PLANNED — not yet served]` prefix and the pin test, both of which this PR leaves correct for `nav` and flips correctly for `withheldMaps` (unchanged from the PASS head). The header's new sentence is the right end state after both PRs land and is wrong-by-omission on `main` only in the window described in ③.
- Tried to break it: no test, script or doc-audit rule reads the header; `check:docs` regeneration is satisfied (the mdx hunk is the exact transcription); no tracker-id rule applies to a module docblock (the `#\d{3,}` refusal is on describes, and the header already carried issue numbers on `main`).
- **Should-fix (ordering, not text):** land after #29742, or, if landing first, state both remaining declared-ahead declarations in the paragraph so `main` is true at every point. **No must-fix.**

**`packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts`** — not in the delta; the earlier record's judgment stands unchanged.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vrj8cl`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZUR3xvHyDPCjNL5P4`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `85d56fc4e07d81342f9b269d77ec4772605e5868`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts + content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts (`assemblePackageExportBundle`, #29755), packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/export.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-bundle.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts, .changeset/28914-package-export-whole-deployment.md

Delta record: two commits on top of `18ad0f5b` (reviewed PASS, record 6595333171) — `c5f0877d` merges `origin/main` at `b3d14150` (brings in #29742, nav served, and #29755, `GET /packages/export` served with its PLANNED marker dropped), and `85d56fc4` removes the header's declared-ahead paragraph and regenerates the mdx. Merge base is now `b3d14150`; the net diff `b3d14150…85d56fc4` is the same 10 files (+691/−41). Read-only: fetched refs, `git diff`/`git show` only; nothing checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) Removing the paragraph is true to the merged tree.** On `85d56fc4`, `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` carries no `[PLANNED — not yet served]` describe and no `DECLARED AHEAD` docblock: the only remaining mention is the bundle's historical note (lines 258–259, "was declared ahead … until the change that mounted the route"). `withheldMaps` (this PR), the `nav` arm (#29742) and `PackageExportBundleSchema` (#29755) are all served, so a member count of zero is the right count and a paragraph naming any member would be false. The mdx header hunk is the exact transcription. **Right.**
- **(b) The merge resolution is correct.** No conflict markers in any PR file on the head. Per file, the net diff against `b3d14150` is byte-identical (index lines aside) to the originally reviewed diff `33ee9aa1…c5a34147` for `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the changeset, and the three new test files; for `packages.ts` the only difference is the trailing context of the last hunk (the function after `withheldConnectorMaps` is now #29755's `assemblePackageExportBundle` instead of `applyPublishedSeeds`) — the hunks themselves are identical; for the spec file and its test the net diff is the reviewed change minus the header edit; `unmanaged-install.ts` is unchanged from the reviewed diff. #29742's text ("served by #28722", line 509) and #29755's (`GET /packages/export`, lines 251–345; route-ledger row 567–568) are present and untouched; the net diff names no file outside the PR's ten, so no hunk of either landed PR is lost. **Right.**
- **(c) Bundle entries now carry `withheldMaps`.** `assemblePackageExportBundle` calls `assemblePackageManifest` per package and pushes its return unchanged, so an entry for a package with a withheld connector map carries the list. That is **in-contract, not a new surface**: `PackageExportBundleSchema.packages` is `z.array(PackageExportManifestSchema)` (head line 318), so the key is declared on every entry by composition, and the bundle docblock's "One producer" rule and #29755's own changeset both state "each entry exactly what `GET /packages/:id/export` answers". Consumers hold: `client.packages.exportAll()` unwraps the envelope without a strict parse; `os package export` writes each entry as it came (`JSON.stringify(entry)`) and only checks the id; `os package install` posts each file to `POST /marketplace/install-local`, which this PR teaches to read `withheldMaps` in both modes; the top-level `.strict()` is on `{ packages }`, which the PR does not touch. The "whole or absent" rule composes too: a connector the execution face answers no body for now fails the bundle read naming that package, which is the bundle's own stated behaviour. **Right.**
- Test exposure checked: the runtime bundle test's protocol doubles list no connectors, so the export never asks for the execution face there; the dogfood round-trip's connector carries `auth.credentialRef` only (none of the four maps) on a real boot that has the face, so its entry carries no `withheldMaps` and its `toEqual` pins are unaffected.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset unchanged (`patch` ×3, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`): still matches.
